The current Go-port `queue.Queue` model simplifies StatusMessages to `[]string` (per `internal/queue/queue.go:193`). When the populated mapper lands, the simple-string form will be wrapped as `[]QueueStatusMessage{{Title: "Warning", Messages: [s]}}` per persisted entry (single-element synthesis), OR the persistence layer will be refactored to carry the structured form. This slice pins the wire shape so the populated-mapper port can proceed without re-widening the wire DTO.

- Doc comment on QueueResource extended with a J323 paragraph cataloguing the wire DTO + the pointer-to-slice 3-state distinction + the persistence-gap synthesis note.

No emit-site mapper updates required. The populated-row mapper port is its own dedicated slice; it will allocate `&[]QueueStatusMessage{...}` from the persisted `[]string` (or the refactored structured form).

## J324 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 16: QueueResource v5-additive EpisodeIDs + SeasonNumbers list-form widening

**Anchor**: post-J323 (QueueResource StatusMessages typed list landed). Continues the QueueResource sweep with the 2 v5-additive list-form fields.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Queue/QueueResource.cs:15` — `public IEnumerable<int> EpisodeIds { get; set; } = []` (v5 plural; replaces v3's singular `EpisodeId int?`).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Queue/QueueResource.cs:16` — `public List<int> SeasonNumbers { get; set; } = []` (v5-only; no v3 equivalent on the wire — v3's singular SeasonNumber sits on the Queue model but is not surfaced via QueueResource).

### Wire contract

Both v5 fields under STJson:
- null → key absent (WhenWritingNull; the `= []` constructor default keeps it from being null normally).
- empty list → `"episodeIds":[]` / `"seasonNumbers":[]`.
- populated → `"episodeIds":[101,102]` / `"seasonNumbers":[1,2]`.

Go-port mapping with `*[]int` + omitempty (J309 pointer-to-slice 3-state):
- nil pointer → key absent.
- non-nil empty slice → emit `[]`.
- populated → emit `[N,N]`.

### Additive divergence

The Go-port shared apiv3 type already carries v3's singular `EpisodeID *int` (from the initial port). v5's plural `EpisodeIds` is the replacement. The Go-port emits BOTH forms on the shared type — v3 wire sees the singular `episodeId` (populated when the singular field is set), v5 wire sees the plural `episodeIds` (populated when the plural field is set). Each surface sees an extra key from the other surface's form when populated; both v3 and v5 ignore unknown JSON keys so harmless.

SeasonNumbers has no v3 wire equivalent — populated-row emits show up as a clean v5-additive divergence on v3 clients (additive, harmless).

## J325 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 17: Quality typed-DTO port + Quality field widening on History + Blocklist + Queue resources

**Anchor**: post-J324 (QueueResource sweep DRAINED at J324). Pivots to the cross-cutting Quality typed-DTO that the C# tree carries on every carrier resource (History/Blocklist/Queue/ManualImport/Release). This slice ports the DTO + adds the field on the 3 stub-emit carriers (History/Blocklist/Queue); ManualImportReprocessItem (body-decode shape change required) + ReleaseResource (broader projection rework needed) are dedicated follow-up slices.

### C# source

- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Qualities/QualityModel.cs:9-15` — the envelope: Quality + Revision properties.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Qualities/Quality.cs:10-16` — the inner DTO: Id + Name + Source (enum, camelCase string on wire) + Resolution.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Qualities/Revision.cs:6-21` — Version + Real + IsRepack.
- Parent resources declare `QualityModel? Quality` on History/Blocklist/Queue (nullable subresource).

### Persistence-vs-wire divergence

- Persisted `quality.Model` at `internal/quality/model.go:58-78` has a custom MarshalJSON that emits the REDUCED form: `{"quality":<int-id>,"revision":{...}}`. This matches the C# `QualityIntConverter` posture used for `IEmbeddedDocument` storage.
- The REST API surface (history/blocklist/queue/manualimport/release) emits the EXPANDED form: `{"quality":{"id":N,"name":"X","source":"television","resolution":N},"revision":{"version":N,"real":N,"isRepack":bool}}`.

The Go-port needs a separate wire-DTO that wraps the persistence model and projects the expanded form. The `QualityModelResource` type serves that role.

### Port deliverables

**`internal/api/v3/quality_model.go`** — new file with 3 types + 1 helper:

- `QualityValue` (4 fields no-omitempty): mirror of C# Quality. Source field is camelCase string per STJson `JsonStringEnumConverter(CamelCase)` applied to QualitySource enum (`"television"` / `"televisionRaw"` / `"web"` / `"webRip"` / `"dvd"` / `"bluray"` / `"blurayRaw"` / `"unknown"`). Reuses the existing `apiv3.QualitySourceName` helper for the conversion.
- `RevisionValue` (3 fields no-omitempty): mirror of C# Revision.
- `QualityModelResource` (2 fields no-omitempty): the wrapping envelope.
- `ToQualityModelResource(quality.Model) *QualityModelResource`: projects the persisted model into the expanded wire DTO. Pointer return so the caller can assign directly to a carrier's `Quality *QualityModelResource` field; nil return would drop the key.

**`internal/api/v3/history.go`** — struct widening:
- `HistoryResource.Quality *QualityModelResource json:"quality,omitempty"` field added after Languages.

**`internal/api/v3/blocklist.go`** — same:
- `BlocklistResource.Quality *QualityModelResource json:"quality,omitempty"` field added after Languages.

**`internal/api/v3/queue.go`** — same:
- `QueueResource.Quality *QualityModelResource json:"quality,omitempty"` field added after Languages.

No emit-site mapper updates required — the populated-row mappers for each family (gated on the per-family paged service ports) will allocate via `apiv3.ToQualityModelResource(persistedRow.Quality)` at projection time.

v5/history + v5/blocklist + v5/queue aliases v3 so the widening propagates to all 6 surfaces (3 v3 + 3 v5) simultaneously.

## J326 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 18: SeriesResource v5-additive 4-field widening

**Anchor**: post-J325 (Quality typed-DTO landed on History/Blocklist/Queue). Pivots family-of-focus to SeriesResource — closes the v5-additive field cluster (MalIds + AniListIds + OriginalCountry + IsExcluded). No alias-break needed; the J316 additive-divergence pattern applies.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Series/SeriesResource.cs:32` — `HashSet<int>? MalIds` (anime MyAnimeList IDs).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Series/SeriesResource.cs:33` — `HashSet<int>? AniListIds` (anime AniList IDs).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Series/SeriesResource.cs:46` — `string? OriginalCountry` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Series/SeriesResource.cs:55-58` — `bool? IsExcluded` with `[JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingDefault)]`.

v3 C# SeriesResource lacks all 4 fields. C# v3 wire emits only the v3 declared fields; v5 wire emits the v3 set plus these 4.

### Wire contract

C# under STJson `WhenWritingNull`:
- Nullable list (HashSet<int>?) → null drops key; populated emits `[N,N]`.
- Nullable string → null drops key; non-null emits.
- Nullable bool with `WhenWritingDefault` → null/default drops key; populated emits true/false.

Go-port mapping with omitempty:
- `MalIds []int json:"malIds,omitempty"` — nil/empty slice drops key.
- `AniListIds []int json:"aniListIds,omitempty"` — same.
- `OriginalCountry string json:"originalCountry,omitempty"` — empty string drops key (with the Go-typical empty-string collapse vs C# null-only-drop).
- `IsExcluded *bool json:"isExcluded,omitempty"` — nil pointer drops key (matches WhenWritingDefault).

**`internal/api/v3/series.go`** — struct + mapper + doc-comment:

  - `OriginalCountry string json:"originalCountry,omitempty"` at the end.
  - `IsExcluded *bool json:"isExcluded,omitempty"` at the end.
- `ToSeriesResource` populates 3 of the 4 from persistence:
  - `MalIds: s.MalIDs` (persisted at `internal/series/series.go:104`).
  - `AniListIds: s.AniListIDs` (persisted at :105).
  - `OriginalCountry: s.OriginalCountry` (persisted at :106).
- `IsExcluded` stays nil — deferred until the importlistexclusion service-join projection lands.
- Doc comment extended with a J326 paragraph cataloguing each field + the v5-additive divergence rationale + the IsExcluded service-join deferral note.

## J327 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 19: EpisodeResource 3-field widening (EndTime + GrabDate + Grabbed)

**Anchor**: post-J326 (SeriesResource v5-additive 4-field widening landed). Continues the carrier-resource sweep with EpisodeResource — 3 missing pointer fields that surface across all 3 v5-aliasing surfaces (episode + calendar + wanted).

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Episodes/EpisodeResource.cs:30` — `DateTime? EndTime` (v5-only; computed = airDateUtc + runtime).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Episodes/EpisodeResource.cs:31` — `DateTime? GrabDate` (v5-only; set by grab-event handler).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Episodes/EpisodeResource.cs:41` + `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Episodes/EpisodeResource.cs:40` — `bool Grabbed` with `[JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingDefault)]` (shared v3+v5).

EndTime + GrabDate are v5-additive; Grabbed is shared but the Go-port currently lacks it (pre-existing gap).

### Wire contract

C# under STJson:
- nullable `DateTime?` → null drops key (WhenWritingNull); non-null emits ISO-8601.
- `bool` with `WhenWritingDefault` → false drops key; true emits.

Go-port mapping:
- `EndTime *time.Time json:"endTime,omitempty"` — pointer nil drops; non-nil emits RFC3339.
- `GrabDate *time.Time json:"grabDate,omitempty"` — same.
- `Grabbed *bool json:"grabbed,omitempty"` — pointer nil drops; pointer-to-true emits `true`.

Pointer + omitempty matches WhenWritingDefault precisely (nil ≡ default-suppressed).

### Persistence-gap deferral

The Go-port persisted Episode model (`internal/episodes/episodes.go:36-70`) doesn't carry EndTime (computed value in C#), GrabDate (set by grab event), or Grabbed (event-derived flag). The populated-mapper port will populate the pointers when those C# Episode model fields land in the persistence layer. omitempty drops all 3 keys today.

## J330 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 22: MediaInfo typed-DTO cluster + EpisodeFileResource.MediaInfo field

**Anchor**: post-J329 (SeriesResource AlternateTitles + DTO landed). Closes the EpisodeFileResource MediaInfo wire-shape gap with a 3-DTO cluster handling the v3/v5 union of two distinct projections.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/EpisodeFiles/MediaInfoResource.cs:9-23` — v3 flat projection: 5 audio summary fields (AudioBitrate/Channels/Codec/Languages/StreamCount) + 9 video/runtime fields + slash-joined Subtitles string.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/EpisodeFiles/MediaInfoResource.cs:6-19` — v5 typed-stream projection: drops v3 flat audio+subtitles, adds AudioStreams (List<MediaInfoAudioStreamResource>?) + SubtitleStreams (List<MediaInfoSubtitleStreamResource>?).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/EpisodeFiles/MediaInfoStreamResource.cs:10-26` — typed stream DTOs (8 audio fields + 5 subtitle fields).

### Wire contract — union approach

The v3 and v5 wire shapes SHAPE-DIVERGE (not just add fields — v5 actively REMOVES some v3 fields). The Go-port emits the UNION of both shapes on the shared apiv3.MediaInfoResource type. Every field uses omitempty so the v3-only and v5-only subsets drop their keys when only the populated-mapper allocates the relevant fields for each surface. Deliberate additive divergence on each surface:

- v3 clients see extra `audioStreams` / `subtitleStreams` keys when the populated-mapper allocates them (in practice the v3 populated path would skip those fields; today the field stays nil so no leakage).
- v5 clients see extra `audioBitrate` / `audioCodec` / etc. keys when the populated-mapper allocates them (similar — v5 path would skip).

Both v3 and v5 ignore unknown JSON keys so this is harmless. The pragmatic alternative (breaking the EpisodeFileResource alias on v5 with a distinct v5 MediaInfo type) costs ~80 LOC + duplicates the per-DTO definitions for no semantic gain.

### Port deliverables

**`internal/api/v3/mediainfo_resource.go`** — new file (~110 LOC):

- `MediaInfoResource` — 17 fields in the union:
  - 5 v3-flat audio (`AudioBitrate int64`, `AudioChannels float64`, `AudioCodec string`, `AudioLanguages string`, `AudioStreamCount int`).
  - 9 shared video/runtime (`VideoBitDepth int`, `VideoBitrate int64`, `VideoCodec string`, `VideoFps float64`, `VideoDynamicRange string`, `VideoDynamicRangeType string`, `Resolution string`, `RunTime string`, `ScanType string`).
  - 1 v3-flat subtitles (`Subtitles string`).
  - 2 v5-typed lists (`AudioStreams *[]MediaInfoAudioStreamResource`, `SubtitleStreams *[]MediaInfoSubtitleStreamResource` — pointer-to-slice 3-state per J309).
  - All omitempty.
- `MediaInfoAudioStreamResource` — 8 fields (Language/Codec/CodecID/Profile/Bitrate/Channels/ChannelPositions/Title). Channels is float64 (matches C# `decimal` for fractional surround layouts like 5.1).
- `MediaInfoSubtitleStreamResource` — 5 fields (Language/Format/Title/Forced */bool/HearingImpaired */bool). Pointer-to-bool matches C# `bool?` precisely.

**`internal/api/v3/episodefile.go`** — single field add:

- `EpisodeFileResource.MediaInfo *MediaInfoResource json:"mediaInfo,omitempty"` after QualityCutoffNotMet.

Population is gated on the populated-row episodefile mapper — needs to decode the persisted `mediainfo.Model` (internal/mediainfo/mediainfo.go:187 — the full 16-field rich blob with audio/subtitle stream slices) into both projections at projection time. Today the field stays nil and omitempty drops the key.

v5/episodefile + v5/wanted + v5/calendar + v5/episode aliases all propagate the widening.

### Tests (3 new in mediainfo_resource_test.go)

- `TestMediaInfoResource_UnionWireShape_J330` — 3-branch pin:
  - Zero-value MediaInfoResource → marshal to `{}` (all omitempty drops).
  - v3-flat populated → 13 must-have substrings (all 5 audio + 9 video/runtime + Subtitles).
  - v5-typed populated → 8 must-have substrings (audio/subtitle stream key-openers + nested per-stream fields). Defensive negative pin: zero v3-flat field leakage. Defensive nullable-pointer pin: `nil Forced` drops; `&true HearingImpaired` emits.
- `TestMediaInfoResource_AudioStreamsEmptySlice_J330` — pointer-to-slice 3-state pin (non-nil empty → emits `[]`).
- `TestEpisodeFileResource_MediaInfoField_J330` — carrier pin (nil MediaInfo → omit; populated → emit nested envelope).

### Wiring

No new routes. Struct + new file + doc-comment widening only.

  - cmd/sonarr: all pass, 4.287s

## J331 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 23: v5 SeriesResource `languageProfileId` strip via response-rewriting middleware

**Anchor**: post-J330 (EpisodeFileResource wire surface DRAINED). Closes the v5/v3 SeriesResource divergence on `languageProfileId` — the field v5 actively REMOVED that v3 still emits.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesResource.cs` — v3 emits `LanguageProfileId` via the hard-coded `=> 1` computed expression.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Series/SeriesResource.cs` — v5 declared shape DROPS this field entirely.

The Go-port's apiv3.ToSeriesResource sets `LanguageProfileID: 1` at series.go:213. The v3 wire emits `"languageProfileId":1` on every populated row. v5 needs to suppress this key to match C# v5.

### Approach: response-rewriting middleware

Two options were considered:
1. **Break the alias** — define `v5/series.Resource` as a distinct struct mirroring v3 minus LanguageProfileId, then re-project per-row in the v5 handlers.
2. **Strip middleware** — wrap the v3 handlers with a JSON-level post-response middleware that removes the key.

Option 2 is smaller LOC and follows the J295 LogResource `method`-key strip pattern. The trade-off: strip middleware adds JSON-decode + re-encode per response which costs CPU on populated arrays. For the v5 series endpoints (paged list, single-row GET, single-row Create/Update), the cost is negligible vs. the LOC savings.

### Port deliverables

**`internal/api/v5/series/series.go`** — 4 handler aliases converted from `var` to `func` wrappers + new helper functions:

- `ListHandler(lister Lister) http.Handler` — wraps `apiv3.SeriesListHandler` with `stripLanguageProfileID`.
- `ByIDHandler(svc ByIDGetter) http.Handler` — same pattern.
- `CreateHandler(svc Writer, emitter Emitter) http.Handler` — same.
- `UpdateHandler(svc Writer, emitter Emitter) http.Handler` — same.
- `stripLanguageProfileID(h http.Handler) http.Handler` — captures via v5util.BufferingWriter, decodes JSON, calls stripFieldRecursive, re-encodes, emits. Pass-through for non-2xx / empty / non-JSON / re-encode-failure (defensive — never emit half-stripped/corrupt body).
- `stripFieldRecursive(v any, key string)` — walks JSON-decoded `any` tree recursively (handles maps + slices); deletes the named key from every map encountered. Handles both array (List) and single-object (ByID/Create/Update) top-level shapes.

The call-site signatures are identical to the previous `var` aliases — `seriesv5.ListHandler(seriesSvc)` at `cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go:1395-1398` doesn't need to change.

The v3-side request-body posture is unchanged: v5 clients can still send `languageProfileId` in PUT/POST bodies since v3 ignores the value and uses hard-coded `=> 1`.

Doc comments on all 4 handlers + the helper catalogue the v5 divergence + the strip behavior + the first-consumer-rule note (same posture as J295 LogResource `method`-key strip — helper kept inline in v5/series for now; consolidates into v5util only if a second consumer appears).

### Tests (1 new with 3 sub-tests)

`internal/api/v5/series/series_test.go`:

- `TestSeriesV5Handlers_StripLanguageProfileID_J331` — 3 sub-tests:
  - `ListHandler strips languageProfileId from each row` — populated single-row response. Asserts `!strings.Contains(body, "languageProfileId:")` + positive `"title":"Show"` confirms other fields preserved.
  - `ByIDHandler strips languageProfileId` — populated single-row GET. Same negative assertion.
  - `Error responses pass through verbatim` — ByID with missing id → 404 envelope; defensive pin that the strip helper doesn't corrupt the error response.

Existing tests (DeleteHandler / EditorUpdateHandler / SeasonMonitorHandler / Type-Alias) continue to pass — the strip only affects the 4 wrapped handlers, none of those existing tests assert on languageProfileId.

### Wiring

No new routes. Handler-aliasing posture changed (var → func) but call signatures preserved.

### Hard gates

- `go build ./...` ✓
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/api/v3/... ./cmd/sonarr/... ./internal/api/v5/series/...` ✓
  - v3: all pass, 1.646s
  - cmd/sonarr: all pass, 3.688s
  - v5/series: all pass, 1.774s

## J332 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 24: ManualImportReprocessItem Languages widening to typed []LanguageRef

**Anchor**: post-J331 (SeriesResource v3↔v5 cluster CLOSED). Closes the ManualImport Languages wire-shape gap that was deferred from J314.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/ManualImport/ManualImportReprocessResource.cs:13` — `public List<Language> Languages { get; set; }` (typed list, same shape as v5 `:13`).
- C# `ManualImportController.cs:60-63` — reassigns `item.Languages` ONLY when `item.Languages.Count <= 1 && (Count == 0 || Languages[0] == Language.Unknown)` AND processedItem returned a non-empty list.

### Pre-J332 Go-port gap

`apiv3.ManualImportReprocessItem.Languages` was declared as `[]int` (wrong wire shape — should be the J314 `[]LanguageRef` typed list). The reprocessOne logic at `manual_import.go:205-214` used the bare int form for the Unknown check (`item.Languages[0] == 0`) which prevented an easy widening at J314 (the J314 slice scope was History + Blocklist + Queue carriers).

### Port deliverables

**`internal/api/v3/manual_import.go`** — struct + logic + doc-comment:

- `ManualImportReprocessItem.Languages []LanguageRef json:"languages"` — type changed from `[]int` (the J314 typed wire form).
- `reprocessOne` Unknown-check logic at line 205-214 updated:
  - `item.Languages[0] == 0` → `item.Languages[0].ID == 0`.
  - Fresh-build `out` from `parser.ParseLanguages(...)` uses `ToLanguageRef(l.ID)` instead of bare `l.ID`.
- Doc comment on `ManualImportReprocessItem` updated to reflect the typed shape + the count-guard semantic preservation + the body-decode backwards-compatibility note for empty arrays.

Body-decode behavior:
- Pre-J332 `"languages":[]` → `[]int{}` ≡ Post-J332 `"languages":[]` → `[]LanguageRef{}` (both zero-length; existing tests still pass).
- Pre-J332 `"languages":[1,2]` → no longer decodes (clients sending int form would fail with type error).
- Post-J332 `"languages":[{"id":1,"name":"English"}]` → decodes to typed list (matches C# v3+v5).

The wire-shape change for populated bodies is observable — but no current Go-port test exercised the populated case pre-J332, so no test churn from the shape change.

v5/manualimport aliases v3 via the existing `type ReprocessItem = apiv3.ManualImportReprocessItem` alias so the widening propagates to both surfaces simultaneously.

  - Populated `"languages":[{"id":1,"name":"English"},{"id":2,"name":"French"}]` body → response body contains both typed entries verbatim (positive substring assertions); decoded `out[0].Languages` round-trips to 2 entries; C# `:60` count guard verified (populated bodies NOT overwritten by ParseLanguages fallback since len > 1).

## J333 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 25: ManualImportReprocessItem Quality widening to *QualityModelResource

**Anchor**: post-J332 (ManualImport Languages widening landed). Same J332 pattern applied to the sibling Quality field — closes the ManualImport Quality wire-shape gap.

### C# vs Go-port pre-J333 divergence

Pre-J333 the Go-port emitted Quality via the persisted `quality.Model` custom MarshalJSON at `internal/quality/model.go:76-78`, which produces the REDUCED form `{quality:int,revision:{...}}` — used for IEmbeddedDocument storage. C# v3+v5 emit `QualityModel` with default serialization producing the EXPANDED form `{quality:{id,name,source,resolution},revision:{version,real,isRepack}}` (per the J325 typed-DTO mapping).

Reduced form is correct for persistence (the DB column); expanded form is correct for the REST wire. Pre-J333 the Go-port's ManualImportReprocessItem.Quality leaked the reduced persistence form onto the wire — a v3+v5 divergence.

## J336 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 28 (A-category, slice 1): history.Service paged populated CustomFormats + Score wire-through

**Anchor**: post-J335 (B-category struct-widening pile drained). First A-category slice — service-port populated-row mapper for the history paged adapter. The calculator engine (`internal/customformats.ParseCustomFormatForHistory` + `qualityprofiles.CalculateCustomFormatScore`) was already ported in pre-J251 work; this slice wires it into the production paged consumer.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/History/HistoryResource.cs:34-46` — `HistoryResourceMapper.ToResource` computes `formatCalculator.ParseCustomFormat(model, model.Series)` + `model.Series.QualityProfile.Value.CalculateCustomFormatScore(customFormats)`.

### Pre-J336 stub

`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go:710` declared `historyPagedAdapter struct{ repo *history.Repo }`. The PagedHistory method allocated `CustomFormats: []CustomFormatResource{}` (empty) + left CustomFormatScore as the zero int — same posture as the empty-DB contract goldens. Populated-row mapper was deferred to "post-Wave-3 service-port arc."

### Port deliverables

**`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`** — adapter widening:

- `historyPagedAdapter` struct gains 3 narrow-interface lookups:
  - `seriesSvc historySeriesLookup` — `GetSeries(ctx, id) (*series.Series, error)`.
  - `qualityProfilesSvc historyQualityProfileLookup` — `Get(ctx, id) (*qualityprofiles.Profile, error)`.
  - `customFormatsSvc historyCustomFormatsLookup` — `All(ctx) ([]*customformats.Format, error)`.
- Each interface declares the single method the adapter reaches for; production wires *series.Service / *qualityprofiles.Service / *customformats.Service which satisfy via same-named methods. Decouples the adapter from concrete service types — enables narrow-interface fakes for testing.
- `PagedHistory` method updated:
  - Loads `allFormats` once at request-start (per-page cache).
  - Per-row: invokes new `computeHistoryCustomFormats` helper.
  - Per-request caches for series + qualityprofile lookups (memoize across rows that share a series — typical paged-history shape).
- New `computeHistoryCustomFormats(ctx, entry, adapter, allFormats, seriesCache, profileCache) (cf []apiv3.CustomFormatResource, score int)` helper:
  - nil-safe — any missing dep falls back to empty slice + 0 score (preserves pre-J336 stub behavior on failure paths).
  - Series lookup → `customformats.ParseCustomFormatForHistory(entry, series, allFormats)` → matched CustomFormat entries.
  - Projects matched entries into `apiv3.CustomFormatResource{ID, Name}` (J302 lite-projection shape).
  - Builds presentFormatIDs map → `qualityprofiles.CalculateCustomFormatScore(items, presentIDs)` for the final score.
  - Negative-caches series-lookup failures so subsequent rows from the same series don't re-hit the service.

The 2 route call sites updated to pass the new deps:
- `/api/v3/history` at `host_wiring.go:1921`.
- `/api/v5/history` at `host_wiring.go:1778`.

Both now construct `historyPagedAdapter{repo: historyRepo, seriesSvc: seriesSvc, qualityProfilesSvc: qualityProfilesSvc, customFormatsSvc: customFormatsSvc}` — all 4 deps are already in scope at the v3Routes() call site, no new wiring threads.

### Tests (4 new in new file)

`cmd/sonarr/history_populated_mapper_test.go` (~165 LOC, new file). 3 narrow-interface fake types (`fakeHistorySeriesLookup` + `fakeHistoryQualityProfileLookup` + `fakeHistoryCustomFormatsLookup`) + 2 counting wrappers for cache-call assertions.

- `TestComputeHistoryCustomFormats_NilDeps_J336` — nil-services adapter → empty CustomFormats + 0 score (preserves pre-J336 stub behavior).
- `TestComputeHistoryCustomFormats_SeriesNotFound_J336` — series-miss returns ErrNotFound → empty + 0 fallback.
- `TestComputeHistoryCustomFormats_EmptyFormats_J336` — empty allFormats → short-circuit empty + 0.
- `TestComputeHistoryCustomFormats_CachesAcrossRows_J336` — verifies the short-circuit gate (empty allFormats means the series + profile services are never called; counting wrappers confirm 0 calls across 2 rows).

The full populated-path test (series found + allFormats non-empty + profile lookup + score computation) is integration-tier and gated on a populated-DB fixture — deferred to a follow-up slice that adds it via the contract-replay corpus. The current test suite validates the narrow-interface contracts + the fallback short-circuit paths.

## J338 — Post-Wave-3 drain, slice 30 (A-category, slice 3): HistorySinceHandler + HistorySeriesHandler populated CustomFormats + Score via optional-extension type-assertion

**Anchor**: post-J337 (blocklist populated-mapper landed). Closes the populated-row mapper for the remaining 2 history endpoints (/history/since + /history/series).

### Problem

The 2 handlers use a `HistoryRangeReader` interface (Since + GetBySeries). 8+ existing test call sites pass `&fakeHistoryRangeReader{}` — extending the signature with a populator arg would break all of them. Need a backwards-compatible way to wire the populated-mapper.

### Approach: optional-extension type-assertion

Idiomatic Go pattern. The handlers receive a single `svc HistoryRangeReader` parameter; internally they type-assert to the new `HistoryEntryPopulator` interface. Implementers satisfy BOTH (production wraps *history.Service; tests use the simpler fake which doesn't implement the extension).

### Port deliverables

**`internal/api/v3/history.go`** — new interface + signature change on writeHistoryEntries:

- New `HistoryEntryPopulator interface { PopulateHistoryEntry(ctx, *history.Entry) (cf []CustomFormatResource, score int) }` — exported.
- `writeHistoryEntries` signature: `(ctx, w, rows, populator HistoryEntryPopulator)` — populator nil-safe (nil → empty stub per row).
- `HistorySinceHandler` + `HistorySeriesHandler`: post-row-fetch, type-assert svc to HistoryEntryPopulator; pass nil or the implementer into writeHistoryEntries.

**`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`** — wrapper + 4 wire-site updates:

- New `historyServiceWithPopulator` struct embeds `*history.Service` (preserves all HistoryRangeReader methods) + adds 3 narrow-interface lookups (re-uses J336 types: historySeriesLookup + historyQualityProfileLookup + historyCustomFormatsLookup).
- `PopulateHistoryEntry(ctx, *history.Entry)` method: synthesises a historyPagedAdapter from the wrapper's 3 lookups + invokes the J336 computeHistoryCustomFormats helper with fresh per-call caches.
- 4 wire sites updated: `/api/v3/history/since` + `/api/v3/history/series` + v5 equivalents now construct via `historyServiceWithPopulator{Service: historySvc, seriesSvc, qualityProfilesSvc, customFormatsSvc}`.

### Tests (1 new with 2 sub-tests + 1 helper struct)

`internal/api/v3/history_test.go`:

- `TestHistorySinceHandler_PopulatorOptionalExtension_J338` — 2 sub-tests:

  - Sub-test 2: wrapper fake (`fakeRangeReaderWithPopulator` — implements BOTH HistoryRangeReader AND HistoryEntryPopulator with a closure-driven populator) → typed `customFormats:[{"id":5,"name":"x265"}]` + `customFormatScore:42`.

## J343 — Post-J342 service-port arc, slice 1 (B-category): Release POST searchInfo fallback ported via *parsingservice.Service.GetEpisodes + *episodes.Service.GetEpisode narrow interfaces

**Anchor**: post-J342 (Post-Wave-3 drain arc DRAINED). Opens the new Post-J342 service-port arc by closing the `Release POST searchInfo fallback` row — the smallest of three sub-arcs in the new priority queue. The Go-port `parsingservice.Service.GetEpisodes` was already implemented (J3.81 era — sits at `internal/parsingservice/parsingservice.go:818`) but had never been wired into the Release POST handlers; this slice does the wire-through plus the helper ladder port.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Indexers/ReleaseController.cs:114-153` — fallback ladder. After the optional override branch, runs three arms when the cached `RemoteEpisode.Series` is nil OR `Episodes` is empty:
  - `:117-122` — `release.EpisodeId.HasValue` arm: single-episode lookup + series-by-episode-SeriesId lookup.
  - `:123-135` — `release.SeriesId.HasValue` arm: series lookup + `_parsingService.GetEpisodes(parsedInfo, series, true)`; empty result → 404 with "Unable to parse episodes in the release, will need to be manually provided".
  - `:136-139` — neither id supplied → 404 with "Unable to find matching series and episodes, will need to be manually provided".
  - `:141-153` — Series populated + Episodes empty: parsing fallback + optional single-episode fallback (when parsing returns empty AND `release.EpisodeId.HasValue`).
  - `:155-158` — final guard 404 if Episodes still empty.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Release/ReleaseController.cs:135-159` — v5 equivalent driven by the `searchInfo` body sub-block (`SeriesId` + `EpisodeId` fields on `SearchInfoResource`).
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Parser/ParsingService.cs:247-256` — `IParsingService.GetEpisodes(parsedInfo, series, sceneSource, searchCriteria=null)`. The `sceneSource=true` path delegates to `Map(parsedInfo, 0, 0, null, series, null)` for the scene-numbering branch; `false` calls the private `GetEpisodes(parsedInfo, series, parsedInfo.SeasonNumber, sceneSource, searchCriteria)` overload for the standard branches (FullSeason / IsDaily / IsAbsoluteNumbering / IsPossibleSceneSeasonSpecial / Standard).
- Go-port already has the implementation at `internal/parsingservice/parsingservice.go:818` (matching signature minus the always-nil searchCriteria parameter).

### Port deliverables

**`go/internal/api/v3/release_write.go`** — 2 new narrow interfaces + helper + ReleaseDownloadHandler signature extension:

- `ReleaseParsingFallback interface { GetEpisodes(ctx, *parser.ParsedEpisodeInfo, *series.Series, bool) ([]episodes.Episode, error) }`. Satisfied by `*parsingservice.Service` via Go structural typing — no adapter needed at the wire site. Nil-tolerant from the handler.
- `ReleaseSingleEpisodeLookup interface { GetEpisode(ctx, int) (*episodes.Episode, error) }`. Satisfied by `*episodes.Service.GetEpisode`. Separate from `ReleaseOverrideEpisodeLookup` (which takes a slice for the override-branch multi-id lookup) so the two wire surfaces stay independent.
- `ReleaseDownloadHandler` extended with these 2 new positional deps after the existing 4. Both nil-tolerant: well-formed cached Subject fast-paths regardless of dep nilness; broken Subject + nil deps → 503 ServiceUnavailable matching the J249 override pattern.
- New `applyParsingFallback(ctx, body, decision, seriesLookup, singleEpLookup, parsingFallback) (Decision, int, string)` helper. Returns the original decision (pass-through) when no fallback was needed, or a clone whose Subject has Series + Episodes populated. The 4 fallback arms mirror C# verbatim. Shallow-clones the Subject via `cloned := *subj` before any mutation so the cache stays pristine — preserves Release / SceneMapping / MappedSeasonNumber / CustomFormats / etc. via Go's struct-copy semantics.

**`go/internal/api/v5/release/release.go`** — `DownloadHandler` wire-through + body translation:

- Signature gains `parsingFallback apiv3.ReleaseParsingFallback` + `singleEpLookup apiv3.ReleaseSingleEpisodeLookup` after the 4 existing deps; threads to `apiv3.ReleaseDownloadHandler`.
- Body translation maps `body.SearchInfo.SeriesID/EpisodeID → v3Body.SeriesID/EpisodeID` when SearchInfo is non-nil so the v3 fallback ladder fires against the v5 wire shape.
- "DEFERRED on the Go-port" comments on `SearchInfoResource` + handler doc-comment dropped — replaced with a J343 wire-through note.

**`go/cmd/sonarr/main.go`** + **`host_wiring.go`** — production wiring:

- `buildHostServer` signature gains `parsingSvc *parsingservice.Service` (positional after `releaseCache *releasecache.Cache`).
- `v3Routes` signature mirrors the change so the param can reach the route block.
- New `"sonarr.tv/sonarr/internal/parsingservice"` import in host_wiring.go.
- 2 wire sites updated:
  - `/api/v3/release` POST: `apiv3.ReleaseDownloadHandler(releaseCache, processDownloadDecisions, seriesSvc, episodesSvc, parsingSvc, episodesSvc)`.
  - `/api/v5/release` POST: `releasev5.DownloadHandler(releaseCache, processDownloadDecisions, seriesSvc, episodesSvc, parsingSvc, episodesSvc)`.
- `episodesSvc` satisfies BOTH `ReleaseOverrideEpisodeLookup.GetEpisodes(ctx, []int)` AND `ReleaseSingleEpisodeLookup.GetEpisode(ctx, int)` — both methods exist on the service so it's passed twice (different interface slots; same underlying value).

### Tests (9 new + 2 fixture updates)

**`go/internal/api/v3/release_write_test.go`** — 8 new tests under "POST /api/v3/release searchInfo fallback (J343)":

- `TestReleaseDownloadHandler_Fallback_SeriesNil_EpisodeIDLookup` — C# `:117-122` arm. Body has episodeId, no seriesId. Validates single-episode lookup fires + series-by-episode-SeriesID lookup fires + parsing fallback does NOT fire + dispatched Subject carries the looked-up series + the single episode.
- `TestReleaseDownloadHandler_Fallback_SeriesNil_SeriesIDLookup` — C# `:123-135` arm. Body has seriesId. Validates series lookup + parsing fallback fire with sceneSource=true; dispatched Subject carries the looked-up series + parsed episodes.

## J344 — Post-J342 service-port arc, slice 2 (Arc 2 slice 1, A-category): Parse handler populated Series + Episodes + Languages via parsingService.Map wire-through

**Anchor**: post-J343 (Arc 1 closed). Opens Arc 2 by wiring the existing `parsingservice.Service.Map` implementation (at `internal/parsingservice/parsingservice.go:1187`) through the Parse handler. The Map fn was ported in the Phase 3.82-era slices but the Parse handler was emitting only Title + ParsedEpisodeInfo since J299. This slice closes the Series/Episodes/Languages population gap; the CustomFormats projection is deferred to a follow-up slice (J345) because it needs the aggregation.Service.Augment pre-pass + a new `customformats.ParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode` helper (mirrors C# `CustomFormatCalculationService.ParseCustomFormat(RemoteEpisode, long)` at `:36-49`). ManualImport — the larger half of the Arc 2 row — is the next-tick candidate after CustomFormats.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Parse/ParseController.cs:31-77` — Parse handler:
  - `:33-36` empty-title null-return guard.
  - `:38` parser dispatch (ParsePath vs ParseTitle by path-presence).
  - `:40-44` parser-returned-null minimal shape.
  - `:46` `_parsingService.Map(parsedEpisodeInfo, 0, 0, null)` → RemoteEpisode.
  - `:48-65` populated-shape projection — Title + ParsedEpisodeInfo + Series.ToResource + Episodes.ToResource + Languages + CustomFormats + CustomFormatScore.
  - `:67-72` Map-returned-null fallback to minimal shape.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Parse/ParseResource.cs:1-22` — wire shape.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V5/Parse/ParseController.cs` — v5 equivalent (empty-input divergence handled at v5/parse/parse.go:79-87 since J258; other branches match v3 line-for-line).

### Port deliverables

**`go/internal/api/v3/parse.go`** — type widening + interface + handler signature:

- `ParseResource` widened with 3 new fields after `ParsedEpisodeInfo`:
  - `Series *SeriesResource json:"series,omitempty"`
  - `Episodes []EpisodeResource json:"episodes,omitempty"`
  - `Languages []language.Language json:"languages,omitempty"`
  All `omitempty` to mirror C# `JsonIgnore(WhenWritingNull)` on nullable `List<>` fields — pre-J344 minimal-shape callers stay byte-equivalent (the new keys are absent when nil).
- New imports: `context`, `sonarr.tv/sonarr/internal/decisionengine`, `sonarr.tv/sonarr/internal/language`.
- New narrow `ParseMapper interface { Map(ctx, *parser.ParsedEpisodeInfo, int, int, string, *decisionengine.SearchCriteria) (*decisionengine.Subject, error) }`. Satisfied by `*parsingservice.Service` via Go structural typing — the wire site passes parsingSvc directly with no adapter shim.
- `ParseHandler(mapper ParseMapper) http.Handler` — single new positional optional dep. Handler logic:
  - If mapper non-nil AND parsing yielded a non-nil ParsedEpisodeInfo → call `mapper.Map(r.Context(), parsed, 0, 0, "", nil)`.
  - On `err == nil && subject != nil && subject.Series != nil` → project Series via `ToSeriesResource`, Episodes via `ToEpisodeResource` per element, Languages from `subject.Languages` (the parser-set list).
  - All other branches (mapper nil, parsed nil, Map error, nil subject, nil Series) degrade silently to the pre-J344 minimal shape — preserves backwards compatibility for every existing test fixture.

**`go/internal/api/v5/parse/parse.go`** — same signature change + same population logic against the aliased Resource (`Resource = apiv3.ParseResource`). The v5 empty-input divergence (object-not-literal-null) remains intact; only the populated branch gains the Map wire-through.

**`go/cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`**:
- `/api/v3/parse` GET route: `apiv3.ParseHandler(parsingSvc)`.
- `/api/v5/parse` GET route: `parsev5.GetHandler(parsingSvc)`.

## J345 — Post-J342 service-port arc, slice 3 (Arc 2 slice 2, A-category): Parse handler populated CustomFormats + CustomFormatScore via new ParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode helper + ParsePopulator optional-extension type-assertion

**Anchor**: post-J344 (Arc 2 slice 1 — Series/Episodes/Languages population). Layers the CustomFormats + CustomFormatScore projection onto the just-landed Map wire-through, completing the v3 + v5 Parse handler's populated-row mapper. The aggregation.Service.Augment pre-pass that the loop prompt mentioned turns out to be a no-op for the Parse-handler call shape (no real Release means no augmenter has useful data to add; the parser-set Languages on parsedInfo already covers what the language augmenter would emit), so the slice skips it and runs the calculator directly. ManualImport handler is the only Arc 2 sub-slice remaining; it's the larger port (~3 service deps + decision-maker integration) and is the next-tick candidate.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Parse/ParseController.cs:50-65` — populated branch:
  - `:50` `_aggregationService.Augment(remoteEpisode)` — Go-port skips for Parse call shape (no-op given parsed-only state).
  - `:53` `_formatCalculator.ParseCustomFormat(remoteEpisode, 0)` → list of CustomFormat rows. Go-port equivalent is the new helper.
  - `:54` `series.QualityProfile.Value.CalculateCustomFormatScore(remoteEpisode.CustomFormats) ?? 0` → int. Go-port uses existing qualityprofiles.CalculateCustomFormatScore.
  - `:56-65` Resource projection — populates CustomFormats?.ToResource(false) + CustomFormatScore.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/CustomFormats/CustomFormatCalculationService.cs:36-49` — the C# `ParseCustomFormat(RemoteEpisode, long)` overload. Builds `CustomFormatInput` from `remoteEpisode.ParsedEpisodeInfo + Series + size + Languages + Release?.IndexerFlags ?? 0 + ParsedEpisodeInfo.ReleaseType` and dispatches to the shared `ParseCustomFormat(input)`. The Go-port `ParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode` mirrors this shape.

### Port deliverables

**`go/internal/customformats/calculate_remoteepisode.go`** — new file with single helper:

- `ParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode(parsedInfo *parser.ParsedEpisodeInfo, ser *series.Series, languages []language.Language, indexerFlags parser.IndexerFlags, size int64, allFormats []*Format) []CustomFormat`.
- Takes individual-field parameters instead of `*decisionengine.Subject` — the customformats package CANNOT import decisionengine because decisionengine.Subject already references customformats.CustomFormat (import cycle). Callers in cmd/sonarr + the API layer hold the Subject and lift the fields at the call site.
- Empty allFormats / nil parsedInfo → nil (the Calculate engine would NPE otherwise; every Specification reads EpisodeInfo).
- Builds CustomFormatInput → calls `Calculate(input, allFormats)` → projects matched []*Format to []CustomFormat (ID + Name + IncludeCustomFormatWhenRenaming).

**`go/internal/api/v3/parse.go`** — new optional-extension interface + handler hook:

- `apiv3.ParsePopulator interface { PopulateParseCustomFormats(ctx, *decisionengine.Subject) ([]CustomFormatResource, int) }`. Optional-extension that wraps the calculator engine + score lookup. Test fakes that satisfy ParseMapper but NOT ParsePopulator stay green — the type-assertion returns nil and the empty fallback fires (J338/J339/J342 idiom).
- `ParseHandler` body extended: after the J344 Series/Episodes/Languages projection, type-assert mapper to `ParsePopulator`; on success invoke `PopulateParseCustomFormats(ctx, subject)` and populate `out.CustomFormats` + `out.CustomFormatScore`. Nil-Series subjects short-circuit BEFORE the populator branch (the J344 fallback to minimal shape preserves this gate).

**`go/internal/api/v5/parse/parse.go`** — mirror change in v5 GetHandler, referencing `apiv3.ParsePopulator` directly.

**`go/cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`** — new wrapper struct + 2 wire-site updates:

- New `parsingServiceWithPopulator` struct embedding *parsingservice.Service + holding `seriesSvc historySeriesLookup` + `qualityProfilesSvc historyQualityProfileLookup` + `customFormatsSvc historyCustomFormatsLookup` (reuses the J336 lookup interfaces for symmetry with historyServiceWithPopulator + episodeFileServiceWithPopulator). Method `PopulateParseCustomFormats(ctx, *decisionengine.Subject) ([]apiv3.CustomFormatResource, int)` runs the C# `:36-49` sequence:
  - Fetch allFormats via customformats.Service.All.
  - Extract IndexerFlags from subject.Release (`*parser.ReleaseInfo` or `*parser.TorrentInfo` type-switch; zero for Parse call shape).
  - Call ParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode(subject.ParsedEpisodeInfo, subject.Series, subject.Languages, indexerFlags, 0, allFormats).
  - Project matched []CustomFormat to []apiv3.CustomFormatResource + build presentIDs map.
  - Compute score via qualityprofiles.CalculateCustomFormatScore against Series.QualityProfileID's profile (qualityProfilesSvc.Get + ParsedFormatItems).
- New `parser` import in host_wiring.go for the IndexerFlags type-switch.
- Constructed once in v3Routes alongside historySvcPopulated + episodeFilesSvcPopulated + episodesSvcWithEpisodeFile.
- 2 parse-route wire sites updated: `/api/v3/parse` + `/api/v5/parse` now pass `parsingSvcWithPopulator` instead of bare `parsingSvc`.

### Tests

**`go/internal/customformats/calculate_remoteepisode_test.go`** (new file) — 4 helper-direct unit tests:

- `TestParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode_NilParsedInfo` — nil parsedInfo returns nil.
- `TestParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode_EmptyFormats` — empty allFormats returns nil.
- `TestParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode_MatchesReleaseTitleSpec` — happy path: ReleaseTitleSpec("720p") matches the Subject's parsed title.
- `TestParseCustomFormatForRemoteEpisode_SizeThreadsThrough` — SizeSpec(0.5-2.0GB) matches when size=1.5GB; pins that the size param reaches the spec.

**`go/internal/api/v3/parse_test.go`** — 1 new top-level test `TestParseHandler_PopulatorOptionalExtension_J345` with 3 sub-tests:

- `MapperWithoutPopulator_EmptyCustomFormats` — existing fakeParseMapper (no PopulateParseCustomFormats method) → CustomFormats stays absent (omitempty) + customFormatScore:0.
- `MapperWithPopulator_PopulatedCustomFormatsAndScore` — fakeParseMapperWithPopulator returns a typed CustomFormat slice + score=42 → body emits both verbatim. Pins the type-assertion + value-routing chain.
- `MapperWithPopulator_NilSeries_NoPopulatorCall` — Subject with nil Series → handler short-circuits BEFORE the populator branch; PopulateParseCustomFormats must NOT fire (cfCalls=0).
- New helper struct: `fakeParseMapperWithPopulator` (satisfies both ParseMapper + ParsePopulator).

The existing 5 J344 v3 tests + all v5 tests stay green — their fakes don't implement ParsePopulator so the J345 hook is a no-op for them.

### Port deliverables

Nil calc / no series → pre-J346 empty-slice fallback preserved.

## J347 — Post-J342 service-port arc, slice 5 (Arc 3 slice 1, B-category): Queue.Service paged surface — scalar QueueResource projection + paging adapter

**Anchor**: post-J346 (Arc 2 drained). Opens Arc 3, the largest arc. Smallest-first slice: a real `queuePagedAdapter` replacing the `emptyQueuePagedLister{}` stub on both /api/v3/queue + /api/v5/queue. Reads the in-memory queue.Service cache, paginates, and projects each row to a scalar QueueResource. Subresource hydration (Series/Episode/Episodes) + CustomFormats + StatusMessages + the v5 includeSubresources[] gating are deferred to follow-up Arc 3 slices.

**Key discovery**: the `queue.Queue` domain model already carries `Series *series.Series` + `Episodes []episodes.Episode` directly on the row (populated by the TrackedDownloadRefreshedEvent handler). So the "Series+Episodes pipeline" the arc prompt mentioned is NOT a separate lookup join — it's projection-only off the already-attached domain objects. This makes the remaining Arc 3 hydration slices much smaller than anticipated.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Queue/QueueResource.cs:58-107` — `QueueResourceMapper.ToResource(model, includeSeries, includeEpisode)`. Scalar fields map directly; SeriesId = `model.Series?.Id`, EpisodeId = `model.Episode?.Id`, SeasonNumber = `model.Episode?.SeasonNumber`. Series/Episode subresources gate on the include flags. CustomFormats from `model.RemoteEpisode?.CustomFormats`; score via `model.Series?.QualityProfile?.Value?.CalculateCustomFormatScore`.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Queue/QueueController.cs:139-171` — GetQueue paging (default sortKey "timeleft").

### Port deliverables

**`go/cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`**:

- New `queuePagedAdapter struct { svc *queue.Service }` implementing `apiv3.QueuePagedLister.PagedQueue` — GetQueue() snapshot → total = len → paginateInMemory (cache order; sorting DEFERRED per the history/blocklist adapter convention) → project each row.
- New `projectQueueResource(q queue.Queue) apiv3.QueueResource` helper mapping the scalar field set (enum fields via CamelCaseEnumName except Protocol which uses the lowercase String() form; Languages via ID-extract + ToLanguageRefs; Quality via ToQualityModelResource; TimeLeft via FormatTimeLeft). SeriesID from q.Series.ID; EpisodeID from q.Episodes[0].ID (Go domain carries Episodes[] vs C# singular model.Episode). Subresources + CustomFormats + StatusMessages left nil/zero (DEFERRED).
- Removed the now-dead `emptyQueuePagedLister` type + fixed the dangling doc reference on emptyQueueDetailsLister.
- 2 wire-site updates: `/api/v3/queue` (apiv3.QueueHandler) + `/api/v5/queue` (queuev5.ListHandler) now pass `queuePagedAdapter{queueSvc}`.

## J350 — Post-J342 service-port arc, slice 8 (Arc 3 slice 4, B-category): Queue StatusMessages projection ([]string → []QueueStatusMessage)

**Anchor**: post-J349. Wires the J323-pinned StatusMessages field (previously always nil). With this the v3 QueueResource is fully populated.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Queue/QueueResource.cs:89` — `StatusMessages = model.StatusMessages` (a non-null `List<TrackedDownloadStatusMessage>`).
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/TrackedDownloads/TrackedDownloadStatusMessage.cs` — `{Title string, Messages List<string>}` with a `(title, message)` single-string ctor.

### Synthesis decision

The Go domain flattened the C# `{Title, Messages[]}` to a flat `[]string` at the trackeddownloads layer (`trackeddownloads.TrackedDownload.StatusMessages []string`, doc-comment: "the typed status-message struct ports alongside the queue / UI integration slice that consumes it" — this slice). Each flat string is synthesised into `apiv3.QueueStatusMessage{Title: s, Messages: []string{}}` (string → header line, empty sub-messages — the natural flat-string mapping). Unconstrained by corpus (empty-DB has no queue rows).

### Port deliverables

- **`projectQueueResource`** (cmd/sonarr): build `[]apiv3.QueueStatusMessage` from `q.StatusMessages` (each string → `{Title: s, Messages: []string{}}`), always set `res.StatusMessages = &msgs` (non-nil pointer mirroring C#'s non-null list; empty domain slice → wire `"statusMessages":[]`). Not include-flag gated.

## J353 — Post-J352 residual-arc, Arc 1 (ImportDecisionMaker spec pipeline) slice 1: port the final two import Specifications (AlreadyImported + MatchesFolder), completing the 14-spec set

**Anchor**: post-J352 (Post-J342 service-port arc complete). First slice of the Post-J352 residual-arc run, biggest-port-surface-first. Arc 1 = the ImportDecisionMaker spec pipeline.

**Orientation finding**: the orchestrator (`internal/episodeimport/import_decision_maker.go`) + 12 of the 14 C# `IImportDecisionEngineSpecification` classes were ALREADY ported (`specs.go`, compile-time guards listed FullSeason / SplitEpisode / SameEpisodesImport / UnverifiedSceneNumbering / HasAudioTrack / NotSample / AbsoluteEpisodeNumber / EpisodeTitle / FreeSpace / MatchesGrab / NotUnpacking / Upgrade). The two unported classes were `AlreadyImportedSpecification` + `MatchesFolderSpecification`. The production spec list (`cmd/sonarr/main.go`) wired 11 (Upgrade is ported-but-unwired pending its ProfileView caching layer). Both rejection reasons + both target subsystems already existed.

### C# source

- `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaFiles/EpisodeImport/Specifications/AlreadyImportedSpecification.cs:11-79` — per-episode history walk; `FindByEpisodeId` → first DownloadFolderImported + first Grabbed entries matching the download id; reject when imported-with-no-grab or imported-after-grab.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaFiles/EpisodeImport/Specifications/MatchesFolderSpecification.cs:12-86` — scene-season-special re-parse, then `GetEpisodes(folderInfo)` vs `GetEpisodes(fileInfo)`; reject file-episodes the folder didn't promise.

### Port deliverables

- **`AlreadyImportedSpecification`** (specs.go): new `ImportHistoryFinder` narrow interface (`FindByEpisodeId(ctx, episodeID) ([]history.Entry, error)` — satisfied structurally by `*history.Service`). `IsSatisfiedBy`: nil download item → Accept; per episode, `EpisodeFileID == nil || == 0` → continue (the Go-port `episode.HasFile` ≡ C# `EpisodeFileId > 0`); else `FindByEpisodeId` + new `firstHistoryEntry(entries, downloadID, eventType)` helper (history rows are date-DESC so first-match = most-recent) for DownloadFolderImported(3) + Grabbed(1); reject `EpisodeAlreadyImported` when imported-no-grab OR imported-after-grab; re-grabbed-after-import / not-imported → continue. Lookup error → Accept + Warn (defensive idiom; C# bubbles to EvaluateSpec→DecisionError). Ctor returns `(*Spec, error)`, rejects nil finder.
- **`MatchesFolderSpecification`** (specs.go): new `FolderMatchParsingService` narrow interface (`ParseSpecialEpisodeTitle` + `GetEpisodes`, satisfied by `*parsingservice.Service`). `IsSatisfiedBy`: nil series / ExistingFile → Accept; `IsPossibleSceneSeasonSpecial()` file/folder info re-parsed via `ParseSpecialEpisodeTitle(info, info.ReleaseTitle, series)`; nil folder/file info → Accept; `GetEpisodes(folderInfo, series, true)` empty → Accept; any `GetEpisodes(fileInfo,…)` episode whose ID isn't in the folder set is unexpected → reject `EpisodeUnexpected` with the existing `formatEpisodeShortIDs` (`%dx%02d`) + `folderInfo.ReleaseTitle` (singular/plural message split mirrors C# `:72`/`:75`). Lookup/parse errors → Accept + Warn. Ctor returns `(*Spec, error)`, rejects nil parsing service.
- **Compile-time guards**: both added to the `var (_ Specification = …)` block.
- **Wiring** (`cmd/sonarr/main.go`): both appended to `importDecisionSpecs` after the EpisodeTitle spec — `historySvc` (line 887) + `parsingSvc` (line 783) are both in scope at the assembly site.

### Tests

## J354 — Post-J352 residual-arc, Arc 1 (ImportDecisionMaker spec pipeline) slice 2: wire UpgradeSpecification into the production import spec pipeline

**Anchor**: post-J353. J353 completed the 14-spec port (12 wired + 2 newly ported); this slice wires the 13th (`UpgradeSpecification`, ported-but-unwired since the slice-5 era).

### C# source

- `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaFiles/EpisodeImport/Specifications/UpgradeSpecification.cs:13-104` — per existing-EpisodeFile-on-disk veto: quality / revision / custom-format-score comparisons; `:30` `Episode.Series.QualityProfile.Value` lazy-load; `:32` `Episode.EpisodeFile.Value`; `:62` `_formatService.ParseCustomFormat(episodeFile, series)`.

### Port deliverables

- **`cmd/sonarr/import_upgrade_spec_wiring.go`** (new) — three adapters:
  - `upgradeProfileViewBySeriesAdapter{series, qp}` → `GetProfileViewBySeriesID(ctx, seriesID)`: `GetSeries` → `QualityProfileID` → `qp.Get` → `decisionengine.NewProfileView`. Errors propagate (spec accepts defensively on error).
  - `upgradeEpisodeFileResolverAdapter{svc}` → `GetByID(ctx, id)`: `episodeFilesSvc.GetFile`, translating `episodefiles.ErrNotFound` → `(nil, nil)` (the spec's nil-row → continue contract at C# `:34-38`).
  - `upgradeFormatCalculatorAdapter{series, cf}` → `ParseCustomFormat(ctx, file)`: resolves the file's series from `file.SeriesID`, fetches the Format catalogue via `cf.All`, runs `customformats.ParseCustomFormatForFile`. (The episodeimport `CustomFormatCalculator` interface drops the series arg the underlying free fn needs, so the adapter resolves it internally.)
  - Compile-time guards for all three.
- **`cmd/sonarr/main.go`** — `episodeimport.NewUpgradeSpecification(configProv, profileResolver, fileResolver, formatCalc, logger)` appended to `importDecisionSpecs`. Placed AFTER the `qualityProfilesSvc` + `customFormatsSvc` construction block (those deps aren't in scope at the earlier spec-list literal) and before `NewImportDecisionMaker`. `configProv` satisfies `UpgradeConfig` (`DownloadPropersAndRepacks`) directly.

### Behaviour

Rejects `NotQualityUpgrade` / `NotRevisionUpgrade` / `NotCustomFormatUpgrade` / `NotCustomFormatUpgradeAfterRename` when a candidate doesn't improve on an existing on-disk EpisodeFile for one of its episodes. Fresh imports (every episode `EpisodeFileID` nil/0) skip every arm → Accept, so wiring affects only upgrade scenarios — C#-faithful since C# registers all specs via IoC. Lookup errors → Accept + Warn-log.

### Tests

No new cmd/sonarr unit tests — matches the J3.92-3.95 wiring-slice posture; the spec logic is already covered by `TestUpgradeSpecification` in `internal/episodeimport/specs_test.go`. Gate = build + existing cmd/sonarr tests.

### Dependency decision

Added `golang.org/x/image v0.41.0` (Go-team module, minimal transitive deps) for `draw.CatmullRom` high-quality scaling — vs. a hand-written stdlib bilinear (lower quality, more code). stdlib `image/jpeg` (q92) + `image/png` for codec.

### C# source

### Port deliverables

- **`internal/mediacover/resize.go`** (new) — `ImageResizer` implements the new `Resizer` interface (`Resize(source, dest, height)`): decode → `draw.CatmullRom.Scale` to (autoWidth, height) preserving aspect → encode (`.png`→png else jpeg q92) → temp `.part` + rename; failure removes partial + stale dest. `NewImageResizer()` ctor.
- **`internal/mediacover/mediacover.go`** — `Resizer` interface + optional `Service.resizer` field + `SetResizer`.
- **`internal/mediacover/download.go`** — `EnsureCovers` restructured to the C# `(cover, alreadyExists)` two-pass shape (download pass, then resize pass over all covers with `forceResize=!alreadyExists`); new `ensureResizedCovers` (`ResizeHeights` tier, skip-when-present+non-zero-unless-forced, swallow resize errors).
- **`cmd/sonarr/main.go`** — `mediaCoverSvc.SetResizer(mediacover.NewImageResizer())`.

### Tests

- `internal/mediacover/download_test.go` (+5): resizes-fresh-download (poster→500,250), skips-present-variant, regenerates-zero-byte-variant, nil-resizer-skips, absorbs-resize-error.

## J366 — Post-J365 resource-projection arc, slice 1: SeriesResource model-intrinsic projection

**Anchor**: post-J365 (MediaCover subsystem complete). New arc per the loop directive — API resource-projection completeness, biggest / most-UI-consumed resource first. SeriesResource carries the densest deferral set, so it leads.

### Orientation

`grep -rniE "DEFERRED|populated-row only" internal/api` enumerated the projection gaps. SeriesResource (`internal/api/v3/series.go`, shared by v5 via `Resource = apiv3.SeriesResource`) had the largest band. The C# `SeriesResourceMapper.ToResource` (`src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesResource.cs:80-145`) splits into two groups: fields set straight off `model` (no service join) and fields the mapper itself leaves to a join/another layer. This slice closes the first group.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesResource.cs:80-145` — the ToResource mapper. Model-intrinsic sets: Seasons (`model.Seasons.ToResource(includeSeasonImages)`), OriginalLanguage, Genres, Ratings, Added, FirstAired, LastAired, AddOptions (+ the already-ported scalars).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeasonResource.cs:8-31` — SeasonResource {seasonNumber, monitored, statistics, images}; `images` only when `includeImages:true` (default false).
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Tv/Ratings.cs` — {Votes int, Value decimal}.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/Tv/Series.cs:11-21` — ctor initializes Images/Genres/Seasons/OriginalLanguage(=English)/etc. but NOT Ratings (→ nullable) nor AddOptions (→ nullable). Added is non-nullable `DateTime`.
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/openapi.json` SeriesResource: `seasons`/`genres`/`images` nullable arrays; `originalLanguage`/`ratings`/`addOptions` `$ref`; `added` non-nullable date-time; `firstAired`/`lastAired` nullable date-time.

### Port deliverables (`internal/api/v3/series.go`)

- **SeriesResource** gains: `Seasons []SeasonResource json:"seasons"` (always-array), `OriginalLanguage LanguageRef json:"originalLanguage"` (always), `Ratings *RatingsResource json:"ratings,omitempty"`, `Added time.Time json:"added"` (always), `FirstAired/LastAired *time.Time omitempty`, `AddOptions *json.RawMessage json:"addOptions,omitempty"`. `Genres` retained but now populated.
- **New types**: `SeasonResource{SeasonNumber, Monitored}` (statistics+images DEFERRED — added additively when their slices land), `RatingsResource{Votes int, Value float64}`.
- **ToSeriesResource** now sets the band: `decodeSeriesSeasons(s.Seasons)`, `ToLanguageRef(s.OriginalLanguage)`, `decodeSeriesGenres(s.Genres)`, `decodeSeriesRatings(s.Ratings)`, `Added` (deref or zero), `s.FirstAired`/`s.LastAired`, `rawJSONOrNil(s.AddOptions)`.
- **Helpers**: `decodeSeriesGenres` (→ non-nil `[]string`), `decodeSeriesSeasons` (camelCase decode → seasonNumber+monitored, ignores images/statistics; non-nil `[]`), `decodeSeriesRatings` (→ `*RatingsResource`, nil on empty/invalid), `rawJSONOrNil` (verbatim `*json.RawMessage` passthrough, nil on empty).

### Design notes

- **Shared type → both surfaces.** v5 `Resource = apiv3.SeriesResource`, so the band lights up on `/api/v5/series` too; the v5 `stripLanguageProfileID` middleware is unaffected (it only deletes one key).
- **AddOptions raw passthrough.** The persisted column was written by C# STJson in the camelCase wire shape; verbatim `json.RawMessage` re-emission is byte-faithful and sidesteps re-deriving the AddSeriesOptions/MonitoringOptions DTO (out of arc scope — that's a write-side shape).
- **Seasons images/statistics DEFERRED** per the same service-join gates as the parent SeriesResource fields; the C# default `includeImages:false` means seasons[].images is absent on the default wire anyway.
- **Empty-DB contract preserved.** series.list goldens are `[]` (zero rows); populated-row additions are unobservable. `test/contract/replayer` passes.

### Tests (`internal/api/v3/series_test.go`)

- `TestToSeriesResource_ModelIntrinsicProjection_J366` — populated `series.Series` (seasons blob w/ images, genres, ratings, addOptions, OriginalLanguage=1, added/firstAired/lastAired) → field-level + marshal-contract asserts (`originalLanguage:{id:1,name:English}`, `genres`, `ratings:{votes,value}`, `seasons:[{...}]`, the three dates, addOptions passthrough) + a guard that seasons[].images (`coverType`) does NOT leak.
- `TestToSeriesResource_ModelIntrinsicProjection_EmptyRow_J366` — empty row → `seasons:[]`, `genres:[]`, `originalLanguage:{id:0,name:Unknown}`, `added:"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"`; ratings/addOptions/firstAired/lastAired keys absent.

## J367 — Post-J365 resource-projection arc, slice 2: SeriesResource.images (MediaCover local-URL rewrite via populator)

**Anchor**: post-J366 (SeriesResource model-intrinsic band complete). `images` is the biggest remaining single SeriesResource field and the first service-join projection of the arc.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesResource.cs:109` — `Images = model.Images.JsonClone()` (mapper; always-non-null list).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesController.cs:125,223,231-237` — `MapCoversToLocal(...)` runs `_coverMapper.ConvertToLocalUrls(resource.Id, resource.Images)` AFTER `ToResource`, at the controller layer (List + ByID). The persisted Url is empty/stale; the local form is computed at serve time.
- `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaCover/MediaCover.cs:16-31` — {CoverType, Url, RemoteUrl}.
- `openapi.json` MediaCover: coverType `$ref MediaCoverTypes`; url + remoteUrl nullable.

### Port deliverables

- **`internal/api/v3/series.go`** (imports `internal/mediacover`):
  - `MediaCoverResource{CoverType string json:"coverType", Url string json:"url", RemoteUrl string json:"remoteUrl,omitempty"}`.
  - `SeriesResource.Images []MediaCoverResource json:"images"` (always-non-null array).
  - `ToSeriesResource` → `Images: decodeSeriesImages(s)`: `mediacover.DecodeSeriesImages(&s)` (frozen-int coverType) → map via `CoverType.String()`, persisted url, remoteUrl; empty/invalid → `[]`.
  - `SeriesImagePopulator` interface + `ApplySeriesImagePopulator(res, svc any)` (J339/J345 type-assert idiom). List + ByID handlers call it per resource; rewrites `res.Images[].Url` in place when the lister/getter implements it, else leaves the persisted Url.
- **`cmd/sonarr/series_image_wiring.go`** (new): `seriesImagePopulator{*series.Service; mc *mediacover.Service}` — embeds the service (drop-in for `SeriesLister`/`SeriesByIDGetter`); `PopulateSeriesImages` rebuilds `[]mediacover.Cover` (via `ParseCoverType`, unknown→CoverTypeUnknown skipped by ConvertToLocalUrls) → `mc.ConvertToLocalUrls(seriesID, covers)` → copies rewritten Url back. 3 compile-time guards.
- **`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`**: `buildHostServer` + `v3Routes` gain a `*mediacover.Service` param (`mediaCoverConvertSvc` — avoids colliding with the existing `mediaCoverLister` named `mediaCoverSvc`); `seriesImgSvc` wrapper built once, substituted at the 4 GET sites only (write handlers keep bare `seriesSvc`).
- **`cmd/sonarr/main.go`**: passes the J364 `mediaCoverSvc` (fs+urlBase+resizer) into the call.

### Design notes

- **Controller-layer rewrite, not mapper.** Matches C# exactly — the base mapper produces the persisted Url; the populator (the Go-port equivalent of `IMapCoversToLocal`) rewrites it at handler time.
- **v5 free.** v5 ListHandler/ByIDHandler wrap the v3 handlers with the same lister, so the populator fires; the languageProfileId-strip middleware runs after and is unaffected.
- **Frozen-int coverType.** The Go-port contract persists coverType as the int ordinal (per `mediacover.CoverType`); the projection maps int→string. A string-enum blob would fail DecodeSeriesImages → `[]` (documented swallow).

## J368 — Post-J365 resource-projection arc, slice 3: SeriesResource.statistics CORE (internal/seriesstats)

**Anchor**: post-J367 (SeriesResource.images done). `statistics` is the biggest remaining SeriesResource piece and unblocks several deferred fields. Split core-then-wire per the J360→J361 cutoff-unmet precedent: this slice = the aggregation core; J369 = the API populator.

### C# source

- `src/NzbDrone.Core/SeriesStats/SeriesStatistics.cs` + `SeasonStatistics.cs` — the models (counts, airing, releaseGroups/types, qualities).
- `SeriesStatisticsRepository.cs` — two grouped queries (EpisodesBuilder: per-season counts + airing CASE logic; EpisodeFilesBuilder: size + GROUP_CONCAT release groups/types/qualities) merged per (seriesId, seasonNumber).
- `SeriesStatisticsService.cs` MapSeriesStatistics — series rollup (sums, distinct unions, MinBy NextAiring / MaxBy PreviousAiring / MaxBy LastAired where SeasonNumber>0, SortQualities by profile).
- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Series/SeriesStatisticsResource.cs` + `SeasonStatisticsResource.cs` — the wire shapes (J369 consumes).

### Port deliverable (`internal/seriesstats/seriesstats.go`)

- **Models** SeasonStatistics + SeriesStatistics (full set incl. the v5-additive MonitoredEpisodeCount / ReleaseTypes / EpisodeFileQualities / AvailableEpisodeCount so one core feeds both surfaces).
- **`Compute(eps, files, now) SeriesStatistics`** — pure, in-memory aggregation (faithful-degraded vs SQL GROUP BY; counts identical to the C# CASE expressions). Per-season: total / available / episode / file / monitored counts; NextAiring (min future monitored), PreviousAiring (max past monitored), LastAired (max date-only AirDate); file size sum + distinct sorted release groups + distinct release types + distinct quality ids (parsed from the bare-int `{"quality":<id>,...}` shape). Series rollup: sums + distinct-unions + min/max airing + LastAired max over SeasonNumber>0; seasons sorted by number; qualities ascending (API re-sorts by profile).

### Design notes

- **In-memory, not SQL.** Matches the wanted/cutoff "aggregate-in-Go" posture; J369 loads episodes (episodes.Repo.AllBySeriesID / AllBySeriesIDs) + files at the wiring tier and calls Compute. Keeps the counting logic in one unit-tested function.
- **Quality id shape.** Persisted EpisodeFile.Quality is `{"quality":<id>,"revision":{...}}` (quality.Model.MarshalJSON bare-int; confirmed vs the J360 cutoff LIKE). Parsed via a local `{Quality int}` struct. The nested `{"quality":{"id":...}}` test fixture in episodefiles_test.go is legacy and not the canonical persisted shape.
- **Specials.** Series LastAired excludes SeasonNumber 0 (C# `SeasonNumber > 0`); season-0 SeasonStatistics still records its own LastAired.

### Tests (`internal/seriesstats/seriesstats_test.go`, 6)

counts (mixed season + specials), airing (min-future-monitored / max-past-monitored / max-AirDate; unmonitored-future excluded), lastAired-excludes-season0, file-aggregation (distinct sorted groups+types+qualities unioned, empty skipped), empty (zero + non-nil slices), nil-AirDateUtc (file-bearing counts but no airing window).

## J372 — Post-J365 resource-projection arc, slice 7: EpisodeResource.series (includeSeries branch) — COMPLETES EpisodeResource

**Anchor**: post-J371. The last remaining EpisodeResource embed. After this, every C# `EpisodeControllerWithSignalR.MapToResource` branch (scalars + FinaleType + episodeFile + images + series) is ported.

### C# source

- `src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Episodes/EpisodeControllerWithSignalR.cs:61-118` — MapToResource(single + list). `resource.Series = series.ToResource()` is the **BASE** `Series.ToResource()` — NO MapCoversToLocal, NO LinkStatistics (those are applied only on the top-level series GET, never on the embed). The list overload caches the resolved series in a per-request `Dictionary<int, Series>` keyed by id so repeated seriesIds resolve once.

### Port deliverables

- **`internal/api/v3/episode.go`**: `EpisodeResource.Series *SeriesResource json:"series,omitempty"` (J302 pointer 3-state — nil→key absent / populated→embed). New `EpisodeSeriesLookup interface { GetSeries(ctx, id) (*series.Series, error) }` (optional-extension type-assertion idiom, J339/J342/J367/J369). New `applyEpisodeSeries(ctx, res, seriesID, lister, includeSeries, cache map[int]*SeriesResource)`: gates on param + type-asserts lister; projects via the BASE `ToSeriesResource`; dedupes across list rows via the optional per-request cache (mirrors C# seriesDict; cached pointer shared across rows — safe, read-only output). `includeSeries` query param wired into EpisodeListHandler + EpisodeMonitorHandler (shared cache per request) + EpisodeByIDHandler (nil cache, single row).
- **`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`**: J342 `episodesWithEpisodeFileLookup` composite gains `seriesSvc historySeriesLookup` field + a `GetSeries` forwarding method (satisfies `apiv3.EpisodeSeriesLookup`; nil-safe → `series.ErrNotFound`). Construction site sets `seriesSvc: seriesSvc`. Propagates to all v3 episode wire sites (`/api/v3/episode`, `/episode/{id}`, `/calendar/{id}`, `/wanted/{cutoff,missing}/{id}`) + v5 episode/calendar/wanted aliases.

### Design notes

- **Base-only by construction**: `ToSeriesResource` is the pure scalar/model projection — the image (J367) + stats (J369) populators are applied *separately* by the series handlers via ApplySeries*Populator, never inside ToSeriesResource. So reusing it for the embed yields exactly the C# base `Series.ToResource()` shape with no extra work to strip stats/local-URLs.
- **Per-request cache**: list path repeats seriesIds heavily (a season's worth of episodes share one series). The `map[int]*SeriesResource` resolves each distinct id once — matches C#'s seriesDict and avoids N lookups.
- **Test fixtures** don't implement EpisodeSeriesLookup → empty fallback fires → embed absent (omitempty). Embedders (queue/wanted/calendar/history) reuse the unchanged scalar ToEpisodeResource and don't call applyEpisodeSeries.

### Tests (`internal/api/v3/episode_test.go`, 2)

`TestEpisodeSeries_J372` (3 branches: absent without param / absent when lister lacks EpisodeSeriesLookup / populated base embed asserting series.id+title AND NO `statistics` key — proves base-only). `TestEpisodeSeries_PerRequestCache_J372` (one GetSeries call across 3 same-series rows; all 3 rows populated from cache).

- **`internal/api/v3/episodefile.go`**: field tag `qualityCutoffNotMet,omitempty` → `qualityCutoffNotMet` (always emit; mirrors C# non-nullable + HistoryResource J312). New SECOND optional-extension interface `EpisodeFileQualityCutoffPopulator { PopulateQualityCutoffNotMet(ctx, f) bool }`. `ApplyEpisodeFilePopulator` refactored: the EpisodeFilePopulator (customFormats/score) and the cutoff assertions are now INDEPENDENT type-asserts (one/both/neither); sets `res.QualityCutoffNotMet`.

## J380 — Embedder/Lister Hydration Arc, slice 2: paged History includeSeries / includeEpisode BASE embeds

Continues the arc. The paged `historyPagedAdapter.PagedHistory` builds `[]HistoryResource` from DB rows that carry only SeriesID / EpisodeID, so the Series / Episode embeds require per-row hydration (unlike the J377 since/series path, whose model-based rows are hydrated in `writeHistoryEntries`).

### Design decision — conditional flags-in-interface (NOT Queue J348 hydrate-then-strip)

Per the arc guidance, the include flags are threaded INTO the `HistoryPagedLister` interface so hydration is conditional: when the client doesn't pass `includeSeries` / `includeEpisode`, no per-row series/episode DB lookup fires. The Queue J348 always-hydrate-then-strip pattern was free only because the in-memory queue row already carried the domain objects; the history row does not, so always-hydrating would add unconditional per-request DB cost. Conditional hydration avoids that.

BASE embeds only — mirrors the J377 `historyServiceWithPopulator` embedders.
- Wired `episodesSvc: episodesSvc` at both registration sites (`/api/v3/history` + `/api/v5/history`). The v5 `ListHandler` / `PagedLister` are aliases of the v3 symbols, so they inherit the new signature automatically.

## J381 — Embedder/Lister Hydration Arc, slice 3: paged History qualityCutoffNotMet

Completes paged History parity with the since/series path. C# `HistoryController.MapToResource` sets `resource.QualityCutoffNotMet` whenever `model.Series != null` — UNCONDITIONAL, not gated by an include flag. The paged `historyPagedAdapter.PagedHistory` was emitting the false default (the field is always-emit, no omitempty, per J312).

### Change (`cmd/sonarr/host_wiring.go`)

- `historyPagedAdapter` gains an `upgradable *decisionengine.UpgradableSpecification` field.
- New method `qualityCutoffNotMet(ctx, e, seriesCache, profileCache)`: decode the row's persisted bare-int quality (`quality.Model`) → resolve the owning series + its quality profile (REUSING the per-request `seriesCache` / `profileCache` the customFormat path already fills, with negative-nil caching) → `decisionengine.NewProfileView` → `upgradable.QualityCutoffNotMet(view, qm, nil)` (newQuality omitted, matching the C# call). Any missing dep / decode / lookup failure degrades to false. Near-verbatim mirror of the J378 `historyServiceWithPopulator.PopulateHistoryQualityCutoffNotMet`.
- `PagedHistory` calls it UNCONDITIONALLY per row.
- Wired `upgradable: upgradableSpecForReads` (the shared J378 instance) at both registration sites (`/api/v3/history` + `/api/v5/history`).

### Design decision — unconditional (not flag-gated)

Unlike the J380 includeSeries/includeEpisode embeds (conditional, to avoid per-request DB cost when the client didn't ask), qualityCutoffNotMet is computed unconditionally: it's faithful to C# (always computed when Series is joined) and to the J378 since/series path, and the field is always-emit so a flag-gate would leave it permanently false. The per-row series/profile loads are bounded by distinct ids per page via the shared caches, so the marginal cost over the existing customFormat hydration is just the profile decode.
